{{Top|leg}}
The '''Animal Circle''' was a region of the main city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. The various circles on Kegan formed an interconnected ring around the [[Gathering Circle]]. [[V-Davi]] hoped to work in the Animal Circle upon graduation from the [[Learning Circle]], but until [[O-Vieve]] and [[V-Tan]] were ousted as [[Benevolent Guide]]s, providing more choice for workers, chances of that were slim as there was a surplus of workers for the Circle during [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. [[Via]] worked in the Animal Circle following their Benevolent Guides' removal from power, and she helped teach V-Davi how to care for animals within the Circle.<ref name="TFFW">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
